verdict.rationale: Oneleet's marketing states it bundles a human-led pentest and real security work directly into the audit process rather than requiring customers to hire a separate firm, implying an in-house/vetted audit capability (oneleet-docs-13, oneleet-docs-38). However, there is no explicit documentation of a vetted auditor network, how audits are booked, or published timeline expectations for completing SOC 2/ISO 27001 certification audits. Missing for 10: explicit auditor network/booking flow documentation, published SLA/timeline commitments for audit completion, independent confirmation of audit delivery process.
